findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The child is the repository own Python advisor, so a run policy on a deep command cannot arise from a real producer today.
findingDetails.case: The child emits a tracked deep command with policy run; the hook brief prints /deep:review (run) and an AI starts a multi-pass run without the offer question.
findingDetails.claim: The hook brief prints the child-supplied policy and owner for a tracked command, where the CLI path prints the tracked ones.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Read the tracked table, the CLI degraded path, parseRecommendations, and the brief after its owner check.
findingDetails.description: trackedCommandForOwner returns the authoritative policy and owner; the brief ignores them and renders the child strings, where parseRecommendations accepts any non-empty policy. A child row can present /deep:review as policy run, contradicting NFR-S01.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade to P2 if parseRecommendations validates policy against the run/start/ask vocabulary and the tracked table.
findingDetails.scopeProof: All three files are review-scope files; the tracked rows and both call sites were read directly.
